commitment.detail: Explicitly rejects vengeance against Zhu Changling and Alia; affirms protection over punishment as core principle

commitment.detail: States 'each person has parents and children' and appeals to compassion as core principle overriding orthodoxy

commitment.detail: Rejects identification with either明教 or六大派; refuses to name谢逊 despite risk of exposure; declines to claim明教 allegiance even when challenged
